description: Ablation of E084's EMA-window confound. Base: E084 code plus the E086 pinned staging. Pin the final-EMA window and the lookahead stop to the tip's step counts (the last 8 steps, indexed from the end) instead of to equal sample counts, which gave ~12 steps at bs 1024. Change nothing else. Run one scored run and an off-seed run on seeds 3-10, compared against E084's off-seed 0.7541 and the tip's 0.7530. If the result is >= E084, use this window in the 32 px trim and 28 px arms that follow.
